name: K1. Failid olemas ja pole tühjad
run: for f in README.md konf/compose.yaml logid/a2-compose-ps.txt logid/a5-andmebaas.txt; do test -s "$f" || { echo "puudub või tühi: $f"; exit 1; }; done; git ls-files --error-unmatch .env konf/.env >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo '.env on repos - eemalda: git rm --cached <fail>'; exit 1; }; exit 0

name: K2. compose.yaml: kolm teenust, Zabbix 7.0 kindla versiooniga, parool muutujast
K3. compose.yaml käivitub ja veebiliides vastab (Zabbix 7.0)
run: sed -i 's/\r$//' konf/compose.yaml 2>/dev/null; cd konf; for v in $(grep -o '\${[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*' compose.yaml | tr -d '${' | sort -u); do echo "$v=ag_$(date +%s%N)"; done > .env; docker compose up -d >/tmp/up.log 2>&1 || { tail -20 /tmp/up.log; exit 1; }; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fs -o /dev/null localhost:8080/ && break; sleep 3; done; v=$(curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json-rpc' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"apiinfo.version","params":{},"id":1}' localhost:8080/api_jsonrpc.php); echo "$v"; echo "$v" | grep -q '"7\.0\.' || { docker compose ps -a; docker compose logs --tail 15; exit 1; }; t=$(curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json-rpc' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"user.login","params":{"username":"Admin","password":"zabbix"},"id":1}' localhost:8080/api_jsonrpc.php); echo "$t" | grep -q '"result"' && echo 'sisselogimine töötab (server + andmebaas korras)' || { echo "$t"; exit 1; }

name: K4. a2-compose-ps.txt: kolm konteinerit Up, veebiliides pordil 8080
run: f=logid/a2-compose-ps.txt; n=$(grep -cE '\bUp\b' $f); echo "Up ridu: $n"; test "$n" -ge 3 || { echo 'vaja kolme Up rida (A2: docker compose ps)'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'zabbix-web' $f && grep -q '8080' $f || { echo 'zabbix-web ja port 8080 puudu'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'zabbix-server' $f || { echo 'zabbix-server puudu'; exit 1; }

name: K5. a5-andmebaas.txt: proxmox2, proxmox3 ja lahenenud probleem
run: f=logid/a5-andmebaas.txt; grep -q 'proxmox2' $f && grep -q 'proxmox3' $f || { echo 'hostid proxmox2 ja proxmox3 puudu (A4, A5)'; exit 1; }; grep -i 'ICMP ping' $f | grep -qE '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}.*[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' || { echo 'probleem Unavailable by ICMP ping peab olema koos algus- ja lahenemisajaga (A5: paranda IP ja oota)'; exit 1; }

name: K6. README.md: ennustused ja vastused täidetud
